intro.t: Steak, seafood and good times on *Main Street.*
intro.text: Castaways is a steak and seafood restaurant at 106 Main Street in the heart of Port Jefferson Village. The kitchen turns out USDA prime steaks like the filet, New York strip and cowboy ribeye, a raw bar with oysters and clams, fresh seafood, tacos and burgers, served with craft cocktails in a bright, nautical dining room and on the patio. Come for lunch, dinner, weekend brunch or happy hour, catch live music, or book the place for your next party.
